Alex C.: Quick heads-up — release cutoff is tomorrow 09:00 UTC. We're doing final buildstamp and changelog merge tonight. If you absolutely need a late merge, add a comment with `/freeze-exception` and link the PR. Otherwise assume soft freeze at 08:45 UTC.

Sara L.: Quick Q — does the runtime minor bump (v1.4.2 -> v1.4.3) count as exception? low risk, unit tests only.

Alex C.: If it's a dep/runtime minor patch that only touches demos and passes CI, we can allow. Need owner approval from Jen.

Jen: I'll review now. If green I'll squash+merge and add changelog line. @Mike FYI for rollback plan.

Mike: If we merge, keep the bump in a separate commit for rollback. Rollback command: `git revert -m 1 <sha>` on release branch. Also make a note in the release notes: `chore: runtime bump v1.4.3 (safe)`.

release-bot: Code freeze rules reminder — merges after 08:45 UTC require `/freeze-exception` and at least one oncall + release lead approval. See <https://redwood/handbook/release-freeze> :lock:

Alex C.: Here is the cherry-pick snippet if needed:
```
# from main
git checkout release/v1.4
git cherry-pick -x <commit>
git push origin release/v1.4:release/v1.4
```

Jen: got it, merging the runtime bump now. Will post PR link.

Jen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/987 — merged. Changelog updated under 'dependencies'.

Sara L.: thanks! :thumbsup:

Alex C.: Sweet. Leaving this thread open until 09:00 UTC. If anything else pops up @release-bot please escalate.

release-bot: Noted — escalation channel: #eng-oncall.
